# Spines

> > Spines is an AI-powered self-publishing platform that empowers authors to publish, market, and distribute books globally with comprehensive tools and services.

Spines provides a complete ecosystem for independent authors, combining manuscript editing, cover design, multi-format publishing, and global distribution across major retailers like Amazon and Barnes & Noble. The platform serves both traditional self-publishers and academic researchers seeking streamlined publishing solutions.
